title: Gender Differences in High-Stakes Performance and College Admission Policies
eligible_reason: Single common reform date. The admission-policy change applies to all students from exam year 2010 (1_clean_gencat_data_RR.do line 301: post = 1 if examyear >= 2010); the main regressions are reghdfe nota_admiss_s female_post female, absorb($baseline) with female_post = female x post, i.e. a gender gap before/after one reform. One adoption cohort; gender is the comparison dimension. Package ships only synthetic data.
design_notes: Stata reghdfe, vce(robust). Outcomes: admission exam scores (nota_admiss_s), college performance, degree composition, AQU labor-market outcomes; year or baseline FE. Some regressions weighted (aweight). Do_files run on the original data (log_file_MS_all.smcl); Synthetic_data_and_code holds fake datasets with the same structure.
data_files_note: README: 'synthetic datasets (fake data with the same structure)'; original Catalan government, AQU and university records cannot be shared (DE-approved exception).
screener_notes: No article text. Synthetic data only.
